Raw hourly closing trade prices; snapshot at Sep 21, 00:00 America/New_York. Short bars show the closing bid/ask spread.
Snapshot YES prices total $1.04; no normalization. Mutually exclusive contracts are not independent forecasters.
Gaps indicate no reported trade close. Last-trade ages can differ even at a common candle boundary.
Source: public Kalshi API, KXHIGHNY-26SEP21; settlement source: The Weather Company. One event does not estimate equivalence.
